facts.fact: The National Electronic Government Plan 2023-2026 says significant investments are being made to develop an all-of-government enterprise architecture that includes a Data Governance Framework, and its implementation matrix budgets ZMW 1,000,000 and ZMW 3,000,000 for developing and operationalising a (national) data governance framework under the Electronic Government Division; the document gives no date of adoption, and its published date of 2023-08-17 is used.
facts.system: Data Governance Framework (National Electronic Government Plan 2023-2026)
